uncertainty_score_calibration.description: Heuristic uncertainty scoring scale reflecting AST mutator certainty, semantic taint boundary clarity, and ownership lifecycle escape risk. Scores are deterministic heuristic rankings, not empirical Bayesian probabilities.

bands.0.05: Deterministic intra-procedural AST mutator (single-file file/descriptor close or error handling where resource does not escape)
bands.0.08: Deterministic SQL query parameterization (dynamic string formatting replaced with ? placeholder binding)
bands.0.50: Uncertain structural finding requiring human inspection
bands.0.60: Unhandled error return in non-error signature requiring control-flow restructuring
bands.0.85: High cognitive/cyclomatic complexity hotspot (complexity >= 15); requires human architectural decomposition
bands.0.90: Resource lifecycle escape; resource returned to caller across functional boundary
bands.0.95: Command injection via shell interpreter (sh -c) or ground-truth disqualified false alarm (NAT-03 class); autonomous modification strictly prohibited

taxonomy_breakdown.policy_rationale: High complexity hotspots (Cyclomatic Complexity >= 15 or Entropy >= 75) represent architectural maintainability issues. Autonomous method extraction or decomposition without a functional specification introduces high regression risk. The system conservatively abstains and requests human architectural review.

Arbitrary shell invocation patterns (e.g. exec.Command('sh', '-c', ...)) pose critical security risks. Automatically splitting arbitrary shell strings into discrete exec arguments requires semantic understanding of shell expansions (pipes, redirects, env vars). Autonomous mutation is strictly blocked by safety policy.

Dynamic SQL query formatting via fmt.Sprintf is a well-bounded vulnerability class. Deterministic AST transformation replaces dynamic formatting with SQL placeholder binding (?) and passes the dynamic variable as an execution parameter. Fully supported for autonomous repair.

sample_targets.code_snippet:
query := fmt.Sprintf("SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE role = '%s'", role)
return db.QueryContext(ctx, query)
